contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy coin, probably a radiate of Divus Claudius II (Gothicus) dating from AD 270 (Reece Period 13). Cf RIC V.1 p. 234, no. 266. Mint uncertain. Diameter 15mm, and the weight 1.36g. Obverse inscription [DIVO CLA]VDIO . Reverse inscription [CONSECRAT]IO
